structure: Single high school course (header u1: 'Grade/Course: Economics / ACCN: CSD2500'). Small tables per page: Strand (Economics) + 'Standard N: ...' heading; then per benchmark a table with Topic, Benchmark text and code (SS.12E.n.m, text and code interleaved across rows), Sample Performance (example task), Assessment (SPA) and a 4-level Rubric (Advanced/Proficient/Partially Proficient/Novice in C1-C4). Page breaks split a few rubric rows.
issues: Rubric rows and 'Assessment (SPA)' labels labeled backup as assessment material; 'Sample Performance' tasks labeled examples.
Benchmark text is interleaved with code cells (e.g. u131-u137); kept together as standards.
u164-u170: rubric rows split across page break (backup).
Course code SS.12E suggests grade 12 but no grade is stated; assigned 9-12.
